displayAddress: Park House Apartments, Park Row, Leeds
description:
***SPACIOUS STUDIO APARTMENT *** Ideally located for Leeds General Infirmary, Leeds Universities, the business and shopping districts, is this delightful one bedroom apartment. The property briefly comprises: Communal entrance with stairs and lift access to all floors, private entrance hall, open plan living room/kitchen/diner, double bedroom and house bathroom. Good transport links and in the heart of Leeds city centre. Available 9th November. Council tax band D, EPC rating C.

Communal Entrance 
Via front entrance using secure entry phone system. Lift and stairs to all floors.
Hallway  
Using a fob system to enter and a lift to all floors.
Open plan living area/Bedroom 
Spacious living area with windows to front.  Wall mounted electric heaters.
Kitchen 
Fitted with a range of wall, base and drawer units with worktops over. Integrated oven with hob and extractor hood over. Integrated washing machine. Part tiled walls. Inset ceiling spotlights.
Bedroom 1 
Glass partitioned area to separate this studio apartment with a double bed and bedside table.
Bathroom 
Fitted with a three piece suite comprising; Bath with shower over, WC and wash hand basin.
Tenure 
Leasehold - 999 years from 16th January 2000
Ground Rent - £249 per annum
Service Charge 
Service Charge  £3204 per annum
